paragraphs: Chapter 906
Episode 228. Battle of Grosh Castle (2)
Could this possibly be a fire caused by a single human?
The demons could only think so as they saw the raging flames pushing into their defenses. Everywhere their eyes landed, bright, massive fires seemed to be dancing, heralding destruction.

Every time Jin swung Bradamante, the sky and the sea were fiercely overturned. Below, shockwaves were causing tidal waves, while above, the blade aura that slaughtered the demons as it moved forward ripped the clouds apart.
“Did the commanders of the underworld remove their forces from our barriers in an attempt to stop Ziefl? Don't they have any brains?”
It was a low, cold voice, but it carried an almost screaming energy. All the demons guarding the front line could hear this voice clearly, which resonated across the battlefield.
There were three demon kings within Jin's sight.
One of them was already buried in flames, melting away without even having the time to respond or reveal his name.
He couldn't even scream in the horrific heat, beyond the reach of regeneration. The ones writhing in pain and screaming were the other two demon kings lined up to his sides.
“Aaaargh!”
“Gah!”
But they had only narrowly avoided fatal injuries. They were in a situation where they couldn't even dream of retaliating.
Where the blade aura did not reach, there was fire, and where the fire did not reach, darkness spread. Murakan's dark chains and breath also relentlessly slaughtered the demons without a break.
If they had used the flesh of Zito they had in advance, the demon kings wouldn't have been driven into a crisis this quickly.

From the beginning, Jin spread the flames to their fullest, bearing the flesh in mind. The blue flames carrying the energy of immortality melted Zito's flesh first. Jin calculated and fired his blade aura to ensure that the demon kings would not use any remaining traces of Zito's flesh.
Given the dire situation of the three demon kings, the rest of the forces could not even look at Jin.
Their bodies were quickly hardening under the pressure of the aura Jin was releasing.

Even if their bodies had not hardened, most of the regular soldiers would have been unable to confirm Jin's position. All they could do was desperately look for a way to survive, avoiding the flames that filled the air.
"I won't kill those who surrender. I won't kill those who run away either. If you can avoid me and escape."
Hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands, millions...
Jin has reached a state where he can ignore such 'numbers'. Numbers alone could never handle Jin.

In the end, if no one who could 'fight' with Jin and Murakan came forward, the defensive line was destined to open up to Grosh Castle. Only if such people could stop the two of them, the numerical advantage of the Demon World Army could mean something.

["How pitiful, demons. Most of you, even if you're just regular soldiers, have surely existed for a long time like our dragons, but have you lived through those long years just to increase your number and meet such a meaningless end?"]
Murakan said as he took the life of another Demon King wrapped in flame. Now there was only one demon king left on this defensive line, but he was only breathing, in effect, he was virtually dead.
The bombardment from the Golden Ship was precisely aiming at him. The rampart was also continuously pouring out a full-scale attack.
Tssssssss...

The main gun of the Golden Ship ripped through the space, leaving a massive trajectory. The lightning gun, enhanced by the heart-core reactor and the power of Faitel, utterly obliterated the last demon king.
Of course, it doomed all the demons in its path.
Soon, Jin created a path in the air with his freezing magic. Jin walked leisurely along that path, moving through the burning Demon World Army.

It was a bizarre scene. The demons turned into ash in the flame, fluttering like pollen, and the massive spirit barrier spread by Murakan supported Jin's back. The densely lined demons were splitting in half to match Jin's steps.
The distant cannon fire from the Allied Forces and the sounds of the Demon World Army and their weapons burning.
There were no screams.
Instead, the whimpering sound of a lucky surviving soldier could be heard. He was sitting on the wreckage of a Demon World ship floating in the sea, in despair.
But he was neither a surrenderer nor a deserter, so there was no reason to spare him. When Jin briefly turned his gaze to him, the nearby flames gathered and devoured him.
"I really can't tell who's a demon and who's a human. Don't you feel something like the sorrow of a single soldier who simply obeyed orders and was frustrated? Jin Runkandel. This is scary."

Suddenly, a dimensional gate opened in front of Jin. Five new Demon Kings were emerging from the dimensional gate. They were the Demon Kings that Sakiel Groshai hurriedly dispatched upon assessing the situation.
Dailus Klauphino, Tican Belgasium, Vegel Milotane, Slum Bakuria, and Regal Fun.
Jin's gaze was fixed on Regal Fun, who was lamenting the soldier's sorrow. This was his first actual encounter, but thanks to the intense poison he exuded, he could recognize him right away.
'It's Regal Fun, I didn't expect to meet him already.'
Currently, the Bamel Alliance anticipates that Regal Fun is cooperating with Kelliac Zipl.
Furthermore, Ragal was one of the top-ranking figures, having pushed Elona to the brink with his unique mass destruction abilities.
"Ragal Fun."

Ragal also had a debt to repay. He had tried to threaten Luna by using the now Ganesto children of Run Kandel. It was also necessary to confirm whether Ganesto and Kelliac Zipel were truly behind him.

"Ha! As expected, my reputation is already known all over the world. After all, I've nearly killed the so-called strongest person in the world, it's only natural, right? Yes, I am the only one in the Demon Realm with the title of the demon, the Poison Demon Ragal Fun."
The other Demon Kings, who came with Ragal Fun's narcissistic introduction, narrowed their brows as if they were pathetic.

They were not originally friendly figures to Ragal. They were all close to the house of Claufino and Belkashium. Jin briefly remembered the information shared by Biseux and recognized the other Demon Kings.

'The Demon King of the Claufino family of the longsword, Dailus, and the Demon King of Belkashium, Ticano. The other two are the master of the ice region, Begel Milotane, and the master of the plague region, Slum Bakuria.'
Most of them were much more prominent figures compared to the Demon Kings that Luna had encountered while carrying out preemptive attacks until now.
"Humanity. No, the strongest human in this world is not Elona Zipel, but Ragal Fun. Honestly, I was a little curious, but thanks to you, the hierarchy became clear."
"Huh? What are you talking about?"
"If you had met the head of the Swordsman's House instead of Elona Zipel that day, you wouldn't be here now."
Swish-!
Jin first scattered his sword qi at the Demon Kings. Except for Dailus and Ticano, the Demon Kings scattered and avoided the sword qi of the flame.
Dailus and Ticano confronted the sword qi and closed the distance with Jin. Dailus even swung his spear and brushed past Jin's hair.
Although it seemed quite risky at a glance, Jin smirked and swung his sword towards Dailus's forehead. Dailus almost crashed into the sea trying to block that strike.
"The previous Demon Kings were too weak and it wasn't fun at all, but it looks like quite competent ones have come out this time."
Meanwhile, Ticano charged at Jin's side, but had to stop while breaking through the pouring black chains.
Those two were the most skilled in battle among the newly emerged Demon Kings.
Dailus was somewhat shocked and pulled up his energy. His stance had almost collapsed with just one hit.
'I was curious about the gap between me and the head of the Sword Family, but at this rate, comparison is even meaningless... I have no choice but to use Zito's true power immediately.'
Of course, Jin was also conscious of Zito's flesh this time.
He had no intention of allowing Dielrus and Ticano to take the flesh. The judgement was made that as long as they were not enhanced, there would be no fatigue in the battle.
As soon as Dielrus realized the gap, he tried to use the flesh, but there was absolutely no opportunity.
He only needed a second or two, but Jin began to press Dielrus so fiercely that he couldn't even dream of that.
"You seem to want to use Zito's flesh, but you should have used it before you came. Were you worried that it would be wasted if I just pulled out after using it in advance?"
"Kuk…!"
Dielrus, barely pushing off the weight of Brada Mante that was pressing down on him like a mountain, recalled the three Demon Kings who had died earlier.
Nowhere on the battlefield did they feel the true power of Zito that they should have used. Likewise, he too couldn't use the flesh like them, so it was a clear mistake as Jin said.

"I am not a soft person who can fight while calculating such things. Looking at this situation, Zito must be pleased. What are you guys to Zito? If I were Zito, you'd look like parasites that just eat flesh."
Murakan also made the same judgement as Jin. He was pressuring Ticano to prevent him from taking out the flesh.

The rest of them also thought it would be best if they couldn't use the flesh, but that was difficult. Even if their ranks were lower, it would only take about two seconds for them to take out the flesh and break it. Begel and Slum took advantage of the two being pressed and were already breaking the flesh.
Of course, if there were people they 'needed to protect', they would definitely have prioritized the flesh that Ragle Fun has.
But now, the only allies are far away at the barrier, providing artillery support, and the only ones fighting in enemy territory are Jin and Murakan. It was impossible for Ragle to take hostages.
'Wow... As Kelriak's friend said, Jin Luncandel is really scary. He's making Dielrus suffocate from the beginning, isn't he? Ticano is not easy either, but in front of Murakan, he looks like a kid.'
However, Ragle had no intention of seriously fighting from the start.
He had no choice but to march because he couldn't ignore Sakiel's support request, and whether the Demon Kings who came with him die or not was none of his business.
That's why he didn't take it out even though he could use the flesh.

'Looking at it, it's only a matter of time before the Demon Kings fall behind those two. Using them as shields, I can run away at the right time. Sakiel, this stupid child. Why is it that Kelriak's friend knows and I know, but only Sakiel doesn't? In the current Demon World, excluding Lord Zito, only about four or five can have a viable battle with Jin Luncandel.'
Unlike in the past, Ragle's loyalty is not only towards Zito. In some ways, he now likes Kelriak Zifil more than Zito.
